scope: Public account and channel governance, not legal assignment of copyrighted assets or financial valuation.

operations.label: Delegate channel work
operations.effect: Granular access to upload, edit, manage or inspect a channel without handing over Google sign-in credentials.
restrictions: Studio permission owner role does not transfer Brand Account primary ownership.
Editor Limited and Viewer Limited cannot inspect revenue analytics.
Managers may delete drafts but cannot delete the channel.
Delegated access may not support all third-party API operations.

operations.label: Transfer primary ownership of a Brand Account
operations.effect: Change the Google Account with primary ownership control of the Brand Account and associated channel.
restrictions: Current owner making change has held ownership at least seven days.
New primary owner candidate has been an owner or manager for at least seven days.
An account must retain one primary owner.
Transfer may require opting out of YouTube Studio channel permissions.

operations.label: Move channel into another Brand Account
operations.authority: YouTube advanced settings and primary Google Account owner
operations.effect: Move one channel and its uploaded videos between eligible Brand Accounts associated with the same Google Account.
restrictions: Destination channel can be permanently deleted upon replacement.
Source-side watch/search history, creator demographics given by owner, and gift settings may be lost.
Destination videos, messages, playlists, channel history and verification badge may be lost.
Opt out of Studio permissions and remove invited delegates if required before transfer.
Requires correct account selection and reauthentication.
Supervised accounts cannot complete the standard transfer.

operations.label: Export uploaded videos
operations.effect: Download creator-owned uploaded video files according to service features and availability.
restrictions: YouTube Studio MP4 downloads can be 720p or 360p depending on video.
Google Takeout is an option to obtain uploaded videos in bulk.
Removed videos, videos with certain strikes or preapproved audio may be unavailable via Studio download.
An individual video can be downloaded at most five times a day using Studio.
Exporting uploaded video does not mean exporting subscribers, comments, monetization eligibility, watch histories or transferable creator income.

operations.label: Appeal channel termination
operations.effect: Challenge a termination through published appeal options.
restrictions: YouTube says appeal can be submitted within one year of termination.
Only two appeals can be submitted within the one-year period and further single-channel limits can apply.
Copyright takedown counter-notifications are legal processes, separate from ordinary terminations.
After termination, YouTube content cannot be downloaded through normal YouTube export while Google data access can remain.

security_principles: Use role-based delegated access rather than password sharing.
Use 2-Step Verification and retain secure account recovery methods, with secrets outside the research repository.
Assign only the least privileges needed; limited viewer/editor access can conceal revenue figures from delegates.
Protect the primary owner's Google Account; deleting it can also delete a linked channel.
Retain original production assets, licenses and rights documentation independently from YouTube Studio exports.
Do not perform channel relocation without identifying both the source and destination and explicitly checking potential irreversible deletion.
Never store private account emails, sign-in factors, transfer tokens, ownership contracts or uploaded content in this public research dataset.
research_gaps: Business asset assignment and legal contract terms
Transfer outcomes and payout continuity verified across cases
Representative channel recovery risk and restoration times
Retention of creator metrics, comments, playlists and income contracts in transfers
Cost of creating independent backup and licensing workflow
